name: Extra Special Torch Attack
body:
You are particularly gifted and have learned an additional pyro special torch attack.

Prerequisite(s): Special torch attack class feature, knowledge of at least one pyro special torch attack.

Benefit(s): You learn another pyro special torch attack, provided you meet the prerequisites.
